prompt: Build the Chinese internet meme character 大笑奶龙 (Laughing Nailong, also called 奶蛙) in 3D with three.js from memory, as it appears in the meme. No reference image is provided. Task (3D, static, from memory): write an HTML page that builds the character from code and renders it from your reference camera. For this static task, render(t) may ignore t. three.js contract: - The harness injects an import map for three.js r187. Import from 'three' and from 'three/addons/'; the only addons available are 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ConvexGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricFunctions.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js', 'three/addons/math/ConvexHull.js', 'three/addons/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js'. Use one
html:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="zh">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>大笑奶龙</title>
  <style>
    html, body { width: 240px; height: 240px; margin: 0; overflow: hidden; }
    canvas { display: block; width: 240px; height: 240px; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { RoundedBoxGeometry } from 'three/addons/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js';

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xfffdf9);

const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ preserveDrawingBuffer: true, antialias: true });
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(240, 240, false);
renderer.toneMapping = THREE.NeutralToneMapping;
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

const ref = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-1.87, 1.87, 1.87, -1.87, 0.1, 40);
ref.position.set(1.15, 2.87, 9.5);
ref.lookAt(0, 1.63, 0.06);

scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xfff8e9, 0xe8b783, 1.62));
function light(color, intensity, x, y, z) {
  const source = new THREE.DirectionalLight(color, intensity);
  source.position.set(x, y, z);
  scene.add(source);
}
light(0xfff7e7, 2.05, -3, 6, 5);
light(0xfff4e4, 0.65, 4, 2, 1);
light(0xffebc1, 1.25, 1, 4, -5);

const v = (x, y, z) => new THREE.Vector3(x, y, z);
const material = (color, roughness = 0.58) =>
  new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color, roughness });

const yellow = 0xffc528;
const skin = material(yellow);
const butter = material(0xffebaa);
const orange = material(0xef9227);
const eyeColor = material(0x48251a);
const browColor = material(0x9b551c);
const nostrilColor = material(0xd08b23);
const enamel = material(0xfff8e7, 0.41);
const tongueColor = material(0xf15063, 0.47);

function group(parent, name, x = 0, y = 0, z = 0) {
  const part = new THREE.Group();
  part.name = name;
  part.position.set(x, y, z);
  parent.add(part);
  return part;
}

function mesh(parent, name, geometry, finish) {
  const part = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, finish);
  part.name = name;
  parent.add(part);
  return part;
}

function ringSurface(rings, reverse = false, start = null, end = null) {
  const positions = [];
  const indices = [];
  const sides = rings[0].length;
  const add = (p) => positions.push(p.x, p.y, p.z);
  const triangle = (a, b, c) => {
    if (reverse) indices.push(a, c, b);
    else indices.push(a, b, c);
  };

  for (const ring of rings) for (const p of ring) add(p);
  for (let row = 0; row < rings.length - 1; row++) {
    for (let i = 0; i < sides; i++) {
      const a = row * sides + i;
      const b = row * sides + (i + 1) % sides;
      const c = a + sides;
      const d = b + sides;
      triangle(a, c, d);
      triangle(a, d, b);
    }
  }
  if (start) {
    const pole = positions.length / 3;
    add(start);
    for (let i = 0; i < sides; i++) triangle(pole, i, (i + 1) % sides);
  }
  if (end) {
    const pole = positions.length / 3;
    const last = (rings.length - 1) * sides;
    add(end);
    for (let i = 0; i < sides; i++) triangle(last + i, pole, last + (i + 1) % sides);
  }
  const geometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geometry.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3));
  geometry.setIndex(indices);
  geometry.computeVertexNormals();
  return geometry;
}

function sculpt(map, rows = 32, sides = 64) {
  const rings = [];
  for (let j = 1; j < rows; j++) {
    const a = Math.PI * j / rows;
    const ring = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < sides; i++) {
      const b = 2 * Math.PI * i / sides;
      ring.push(map(Math.sin(a) * Math.cos(b), Math.cos(a), Math.sin(a) * Math.sin(b)));
    }
    rings.push(ring);
  }
  return ringSurface(rings, true, map(0, 1, 0), map(0, -1, 0));
}

function ellipsoid(parent, name, finish, x, y, z, sx, sy, sz) {
  const part = mesh(parent, name, new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 40, 24), finish);
  part.position.set(x, y, z);
  part.scale.set(sx, sy, sz);
  return part;
}

function sweep(parent, name, points, radius, finish, rows = 32, sides = 22) {
  const curve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(points);
  const frames = curve.computeFrenetFrames(rows, false);
  const rings = [];
  for (let j = 1; j < rows; j++) {
    const t = j / rows;
    const center = curve.getPointAt(t);
    const r = radius(t);
    const ring = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < sides; i++) {
      const a = 2 * Math.PI * i / sides;
      ring.push(center.clone()
        .addScaledVector(frames.normals[j], r * Math.cos(a))
        .addScaledVector(frames.binormals[j], r * Math.sin(a)));
    }
    rings.push(ring);
  }
  return mesh(parent, name, ringSurface(rings, true, points[0], points[points.length - 1]), finish);
}

const nailong = group(scene, '大笑奶龙 — Laughing Nailong');
const torso = group(nailong, 'torso', 0, 1.01, 0);

function bodyPoint(x, y, z) {
  const lower = 1 - 0.21 * y;
  return v(0.93 * x * lower, 0.94 * y, 0.68 * z * lower - 0.055 * y);
}
mesh(torso, 'pear-shaped body', sculpt(bodyPoint), skin);

function bellyPoint(x, y) {
  const p = bodyPoint(x, y, Math.sqrt(1 - x * x - y * y));
  return p.addScaledVector(v(x, y, 1).normalize(), 0.005);
}
const bellyRings = [];
for (let j = 1; j <= 18; j++) {
  const r = j / 18;
  bellyRings.push(Array.from({ length: 72 }, (_, i) => {
    const a = 2 * Math.PI * i / 72;
    return bellyPoint(0.76 * r * Math.cos(a), -0.105 + 0.73 * r * Math.sin(a));
  }));
}
mesh(torso, 'cream tummy', ringSurface(bellyRings, false, bellyPoint(0, -0.105)), butter);

const tail = group(nailong, 'tail', 0, 0.55, -0.43);
sweep(tail, 'curving tail', [
  v(0, 0.03, 0.11), v(0.06, -0.09, -0.24), v(0.23, -0.14, -0.55),
  v(0.43, -0.06, -0.79), v(0.54, 0.12, -0.96)
], (t) => 0.32 * Math.pow(1 - t, 0.73) * Math.sin(Math.min(1, 8 * t) * Math.PI / 2),
skin, 42, 32);

const spine = group(torso, 'body dorsal scales');
function scale(parent, name, x, y, z, size, angle = 0) {
  const part = mesh(parent, name, sculpt((u, w, q) => v(
    size * 0.105 * u * (0.94 + 0.28 * q),
    size * (0.185 * w * (0.88 + 0.30 * q) + 0.073 * Math.max(0, -q)),
    size * 0.165 * q
  ), 20, 32), orange);
  part.position.set(x, y, z);
  part.rotation.x = angle;
}

scale(spine, 'upper scale', 0, 0.45, -0.58, 0.92);
scale(spine, 'middle scale', 0, 0.14, -0.66, 1);
scale(spine, 'lower scale', 0, -0.19, -0.69, 0.89, -0.21);
scale(tail, 'tail-base scale', 0.12, 0.025, -0.34, 0.71, -0.66);
scale(tail, 'tail-tip scale', 0.31, -0.01, -0.63, 0.52, -0.87);

for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
  const label = side < 0 ? 'left' : 'right';
  const foot = group(nailong, `${label} foot`, side * 0.49, 0.237, 0.30);
  foot.rotation.y = side * 0.20;
  mesh(foot, 'rounded foot and toes', sculpt((x, y, z) => {
    const toes = 0.022 * Math.pow(Math.max(0, z), 5) * Math.cos(10.5 * x);
    return v(0.37 * x * (1 + 0.10 * z), 0.231 * y * (1 - 0.13 * z), 0.454 * z + toes);
  }), skin);

  const lift = side < 0 ? 0.045 : 0.11;
  const arm = group(nailong, `${label} arm`, side * 0.73, 1.47 + lift, 0.075);
  sweep(arm, 'bent arm', [
    v(-side * 0.09, 0.08, -0.06), v(side * 0.18, -0.14, 0.06),
    v(side * 0.29, -0.34, 0.21), v(side * 0.19, -0.36, 0.39),
    v(side * 0.05, -0.34, 0.54)
  ], (t) => 0.199 * Math.pow(Math.sin(Math.PI * t), 0.36), skin);
  const hand = group(arm, `${label} hand`, side * 0.105, -0.355, 0.52);
  hand.rotation.z = side * 0.28;
  ellipsoid(hand, 'palm', skin, 0, 0, 0, 0.204, 0.149, 0.161);
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    ellipsoid(hand, `finger ${i + 1}`, skin, side * (0.097 - 0.087 * i),
      -0.074 + 0.011 * i, 0.053 + 0.014 * i, 0.081, 0.089, 0.113);
  }
}

const head = group(nailong, 'head', 0, 2.34, 0.07);
head.rotation.set(-0.105, -0.055, -0.048);

const width = 1.36;
const height = 0.90;
const square = (x) => x * x;

function headPoint(u, w, q) {
  const brow = 0.038 * Math.exp(-square((Math.abs(u) - 0.34) / 0.20))
    * THREE.MathUtils.smoothstep(w, 0.59, 0.95);
  const front = Math.max(q, 0);
  const muzzle = 0.14 * Math.pow(front, 1.6) * Math.exp(-square((w + 0.13) / 0.43));
  const lids = 0.038 * front * Math.exp(
    -square((Math.abs(u) - 0.38) / 0.21) - square((w - 0.51) / 0.20)
  );
  return v(
    width * u * (1 + 0.049 * (1 - w * w) - 0.085 * w),
    height * (w + 0.092 * w * (1 - w * w)) + brow,
    0.927 * q + 0.016 * w + muzzle + lids
  );
}
function face(x, y) {
  const u = x / width;
  const w = y / height;
  return headPoint(u, w, Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, 1 - u * u - w * w)));
}

const rimCurve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3([
  v(1.015, -0.035, 0), v(0.94, 0.129, 0), v(0.68, 0.180, 0),
  v(0.31, 0.151, 0), v(0, 0.138, 0), v(-0.30, 0.157, 0),
  v(-0.69, 0.186, 0), v(-0.95, 0.134, 0), v(-1.02, -0.023, 0),
  v(-0.92, -0.238, 0), v(-0.67, -0.441, 0), v(-0.35, -0.551, 0),
  v(0, -0.586, 0), v(0.36, -0.548, 0), v(0.68, -0.433, 0),
  v(0.92, -0.236, 0)
], true, 'centripetal');

const lipRise = 0.031;
const rim = Array.from({ length: 128 }, (_, i) => {
  const p = rimCurve.getPoint(i / 128);
  const u = p.x / width;
  const w = p.y / height;
  const r = Math.hypot(u, w);
  const front = face(p.x, p.y);
  front.z += lipRise;
  return { u: u / r, w: w / r, angle: Math.asin(r), front };
});

const headRings = [];
for (let j = 0; j < 62; j++) {
  headRings.push(rim.map(({ u, w, angle }) => {
    const delta = (Math.PI - angle) * j / 62;
    const a = angle + delta;
    const p = headPoint(u * Math.sin(a), w * Math.sin(a), Math.cos(a));
    p.z += lipRise * Math.exp(-square(delta / 0.109));
    return p;
  }));
}
mesh(head, 'sculpted head and lip', ringSurface(headRings, false, null, headPoint(0, 0, -1)), skin);

const headScales = group(head, 'head dorsal scales');
scale(headScales, 'upper head scale', 0, 0.34, -0.855, 0.96, 0.28);
scale(headScales, 'lower head scale', 0, -0.02, -0.919, 1.03);

const mouth = group(head, 'open laughing mouth');
const throat = v(0, -0.20, 0.445);
const innerRings = [];
const cavityColors = [];
const deepWine = new THREE.Color(0x3d101b);
const mouthEdge = new THREE.Color(0xac4734);
const lowerLip = new THREE.Color(0xd66a46);
for (let j = 0; j < 28; j++) {
  const a = Math.PI / 2 * j / 28;
  const r = Math.cos(a);
  innerRings.push(rim.map(({ front }) => {
    const lip = mouthEdge.clone().lerp(lowerLip, THREE.MathUtils.smoothstep(-front.y, 0.02, 0.58));
    const c = deepWine.clone().lerp(lip, Math.exp(-j * 0.26));
    cavityColors.push(c.r, c.g, c.b);
    return v(
      front.x * r,
      throat.y + (front.y - throat.y) * r,
      throat.z + (front.z - throat.z) * (1 - Math.sin(a))
    );
  }));
}
cavityColors.push(deepWine.r, deepWine.g, deepWine.b);
const cavity = ringSurface(innerRings, true, null, throat);
cavity.setAttribute('color', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(cavityColors, 3));
mesh(mouth, 'recessed mouth interior', cavity,
  new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.87 }));

const teeth = group(mouth, 'upper teeth');
for (const [i, x] of [-0.639, -0.415, -0.145, 0.139, 0.412, 0.638].entries()) {
  const middle = 1 - Math.abs(x) / 0.78;
  const p = face(x, 0.115 + 0.048 * Math.abs(x));
  const tooth = mesh(teeth, `tooth ${i + 1}`, new RoundedBoxGeometry(
    0.166 + 0.115 * middle, 0.123 + 0.052 * middle, 0.139, 4, 0.043
  ), enamel);
  tooth.position.copy(p);
  tooth.position.z -= 0.115;
  tooth.rotation.y = 0.64 * x;
  tooth.rotation.z = 0.10 * x;
}

const tongue = group(mouth, 'tongue', 0.012, -0.412, 0.754);
mesh(tongue, 'soft tongue with center groove', sculpt((x, y, z) => {
  const groove = 0.023 * Math.exp(-square(x / 0.115)) * Math.max(0, y);
  return v(0.495 * x, 0.113 * y - 0.049 * z - groove, 0.184 * z);
}), tongueColor);

const eyes = group(head, 'squeezed laughing eyes');
const cheeks = group(head, 'orange cheeks');
const snout = group(head, 'nostrils');

function faceStroke(parent, name, coords, thickness, finish) {
  const curve = coords.map(([x, y]) => {
    const p = face(x, y);
    p.z += 0.012;
    return p;
  });
  sweep(parent, name, curve, (t) => thickness * Math.pow(Math.sin(Math.PI * t), 0.48),
    finish, 28, 16);
}

for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
  const label = side < 0 ? 'left' : 'right';
  const eye = group(eyes, `${label} eye`);
  faceStroke(eye, 'closed eyelid', [
    [side * 0.253, 0.414], [side * 0.359, 0.518], [side * 0.493, 0.563],
    [side * 0.627, 0.514], [side * 0.755, 0.385]
  ], 0.044, eyeColor);
  faceStroke(eye, 'raised eyebrow', [
    [side * 0.349, 0.679], [side * 0.456, 0.716],
    [side * 0.548, 0.714], [side * 0.626, 0.679]
  ], 0.027, browColor);

  const nostril = face(side * 0.135, 0.264);
  const dimple = ellipsoid(snout, `${label} nostril`, nostrilColor,
    nostril.x, nostril.y, nostril.z - 0.005, 0.036, 0.021, 0.014);
  dimple.rotation.z = side * 0.24;

  const cheekPoint = (r, a) => {
    const p = face(side * 1.122 + 0.148 * r * Math.cos(a), 0.127 + 0.108 * r * Math.sin(a));
    p.z += 0.009;
    return p;
  };
  const rings = [];
  const colors = [];
  const gold = new THREE.Color(yellow);
  const blush = new THREE.Color(0xff941e);
  for (let j = 1; j <= 14; j++) {
    const r = j / 14;
    const c = blush.clone().lerp(gold, THREE.MathUtils.smoothstep(r, 0.52, 1));
    rings.push(Array.from({ length: 56 }, (_, i) => {
      colors.push(c.r, c.g, c.b);
      return cheekPoint(r, 2 * Math.PI * i / 56);
    }));
  }
  colors.push(blush.r, blush.g, blush.b);
  const cheek = ringSurface(rings, false, cheekPoint(0, 0));
  cheek.setAttribute('color', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(colors, 3));
  mesh(cheeks, `${label} blush`, cheek,
    new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.58 }));
}

const shadow = new THREE.Mesh(
  new THREE.PlaneGeometry(4.0, 2.9),
  new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
    transparent: true,
    depthWrite: false,
    vertexShader: `
      varying vec2 uvPosition;
      void main() {
        uvPosition = uv;
        gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
      }
    `,
    fragmentShader: `
      varying vec2 uvPosition;
      void main() {
        vec2 p = (uvPosition - vec2(0.5)) * 2.0;
        float radius = dot(p, p);
        float soft = 0.15 * exp(-4.2 * radius) * (1.0 - smoothstep(0.65, 1.0, radius));
        vec2 left = (p - vec2(-0.24, -0.27)) * vec2(4.8, 5.5);
        vec2 right = (p - vec2(0.24, -0.27)) * vec2(4.8, 5.5);
        float contact = 0.12 * (exp(-dot(left, left)) + exp(-dot(right, right)));
        gl_FragColor = vec4(0.43, 0.31, 0.20, soft + contact);
      }
    `
  })
);
shadow.name = 'soft ground contact';
shadow.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
shadow.position.set(0, 0.004, -0.08);
scene.add(shadow);

function render(t) {
  renderer.render(scene, ref);
}

render(0);
window.nwb = { scene, renderer, cameras: { ref }, characters: [nailong], render, ready: true };
</script>
</body>
